_comment: Canonical fxc /T ps_5_0 /O3 sha1 baselines for reconstructed deferred-pipeline PSes. Captured post-Tier-1-spec-hardening. Update with verify-shader-roundtrip.ps1 --update-baselines after a deliberate refactor.

shaders.name: ambient_ibl_pass
shaders.invariant: Re-baselined for the SSSS blur center-source fix against corpus blob 3559. The bilateral blur's center (per-tap lerp target + 0.560479 center weight) and the non-skin ambient base both use the t10 center sample (corpus r8, insn 21), not skinAux/iblLitBlend; skinAux (t4) is an additive ambient term (insn 255). Six further fidelity bugs found by shader_exec_diff.py (all missed by corpus-diff, which reported 44/44 samples PASS): t2 material channels are .y (IBL gate + cubemap array slice) and .z (gloss), not .x/.y; roughFactor = min(sqrt(rough01), 1) computed unconditionally (corpus rsq->rcp->min yields 0 at rough01=0), not a guarded 1/sqrt returning 1 for rough01<=0; final modulation multiplies glossFactor (r0.z, insn 258), not linearizedDepth; skin ring-tap material-id reads t3.w, not t3.x; probe-B reads t12.xyz, not t12.xyw. shader_exec_diff.py (shaped inputs): PASS, 0/2097152 divergent channels, max abs 4.9e-4.

shaders.name: bsdf_light_deferred_directional
shaders.invariant: Re-baselined for the drop-in contract fix + BRDF reconstruction against corpus blob 3295. Changes: (1) input signature POSITION interpolant moved to semantic index 14 to byte-match the game ISGN (contract FAIL->PASS); (2) recovered the default-branch Cook-Torrance specular (Smith geometry/visibility, ge/eq/movc peak-selection, Fresnel-Schlick) that was previously condensed to Blinn-Phong; (3) skin branch dots the t2 sample's xyz (its own normal), not the octahedral t1 normal, per corpus insns 140-141. shader_corpus_diff.py: CONTRACT PASS, stream -5.1%, samples 8/8, temps 11/11. Historical: an earlier baseline (085625AF, locked at 5845b9e) had a posViewLen-vs-roughness01 ambient-multiplier bug fixed 2026-05-20 (F614C18D). Fidelity is guarded by shader_exec_diff.py (differential WARP execution vs the game corpus on shaped inputs) -- the real proof -- with shader_corpus_diff.py as the static contract check; this sha1 is only a drift alarm and is NOT set in stone -- re-baseline it for any corpus-justified fix. Two further fidelity bugs found by shader_exec_diff.py, both missed by corpus-diff: distance fade is 1 - D^8 (corpus insns 121-127), not 1 - D^4; per-cascade shadow bias scales the depth reciprocal by 0.275 for cascade 0 (insn 48) and 1.0 for cascade 1 (insn 83), via a biasScale param. shader_exec_diff.py (shaped inputs): PASS, 0/4194304 divergent channels, max abs 2.1e-7.

shaders.name: deferred_composite
shaders._baseline_history: Re-baselined 2026-05-23: applied near/far depth threshold equality fix (< -> <=) and promoted CB12 + CB2 field names + SRV role names to the RE-handoff HIGH-confidence semantics (FogState struct decode, SunDirection/SunColor, kGbufferMaterial.w material-id channel, direct-light diffuse/specular splits). Prior baselines: 06C040D0 (2026-05-20, fixed matId .y->.w, depth .y->.x, sunlit-color base secondaryColor->fogColor); 95D10F9E (original, black-screened in smoke). After this re-baseline, the post-fix corpus diff (Fallout4RE Scratch/composite-postfix-2026-05-23.md) reports -6/-6.7% instruction-count delta with EXACT match on resources, signature, declarations, and sample count. The tool also reports MISMATCH due to instruction-stream divergence after fxc reorders the emitted asm; manual review shows the flagged literals (4.0, 66.666672, 1.0) and cb references (cb12[14], [35], [44], cb2[1].w, [2].w) are all present in the HLSL at logically-matching sites and the tool's by-index alignment slipped. A future stream-alignment-aware diff (CFG reconstruction, per-node compare) is the right way to fully close the verdict; treat the current MISMATCH as structural noise, not a known semantic miss.

shaders.name: deferred_prepass
shaders._note: Decode-contract REFERENCE (SSGI/SSS read its G-buffer output); not replaced. The game runtime PS bytecode is byte-identical to the .fxp blob. Re-baselined: the tangent-normal read was corrected from t1.zw to t1.xy -- the corpus sample 't1.zwxy -> r1.zw' followed by 'mad r2.xy, r1.zwzz' reads texture channels t1.x/t1.y (the .zw was a destination-register-vs-source-channel misread). shader_exec_diff.py (shaped inputs, full branch coverage): PASS, 0 divergent, max abs 0.0 -- exact behavioral match with the corpus.
